newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Canada satisified with currency moves since G7.
newsitem.headline: Canada satisified with currency moves since G7.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin voiced satisfaction with the way currency markets have moved since the February 8 Group of Seven (G7) meeting.
"There is a general feeling that things are unfolding well and unfolding as they should," he told reporters gathered here for the meeting of Asia-Pacific finance ministers.

On February 8, the G7 -- Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States -- said that major misalignments of the currency markets had been corrected, signaling their desire for currency stability.
Martin also voiced general understanding of the Federal Reserve's decision late last month to raise interest rates for the first time in more that two years.
"The general view is that we want to see American growth sustained and we recognise that there were certain action that need to be taken," he said.
